stories.headline: Oracle raises $20 billion for AI cloud expansion
stories.summary: Oracle is raising $10 billion each in equity and debt to fund cloud expansion. Its shares fell 8.8%; the financing highlights both AI demand and concern about the cost of building capacity.

stories.headline: AI borrowing wave reaches Europe's bond markets
stories.summary: US technology companies are increasingly borrowing in euros to finance AI investment. Reuters reports $39.3 billion of European issuance; investors warn that further supply could raise borrowing costs.

stories.headline: Election Day puts control of Congress at stake
stories.summary: Americans vote for all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats. Polling favors Democrats taking the House, while Senate control remains uncertain. These are expectations, not election results.

stories.headline: US officials report defensive strikes on Iran
stories.summary: US officials describe strikes on Qeshm Island as limited action against air defenses, not a return to major combat. Iranian media reported explosions; CENTCOM had not responded to Reuters.

stories.headline: Ukraine says Russian bombing killed 31
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials say Russian bombing hit a school used for aid distribution in Komyshuvakha, killing 31. Russia says it struck a military target. The competing claims and toll are not independently verified.
